prompt: `plan.py` and `report.py` each have their own copy of the code that formats a number of hours as text like `5h 07m`. Move it into a single function `format_duration(hours: float) -> str` in a new module `src/trailhead/timefmt.py`, and make both modules use it. The output must not change.
bash_commands: git status --short && find . -path ./.git -prune -o -type f -print | head -100 && cat src/trailhead/plan.py && echo ---- && cat src/trailhead/report.py

grep -rn "divmod\|h {\|:02d" src tests; echo ---; cat src/trailhead/__init__.py; echo ---; cat tests/test_plan.py | head -40; echo ---; grep -n "time\|h " tests/test_report.py | head; cat pyproject.toml

(python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -15); (python -m ruff check src tests 2>&1 | tail -5); (python -m mypy 2>&1 | tail -3); git stash -q && (python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -1); git stash pop -q && git status --short
